h_curr[1]) < 2:\n                continue\n                \n            state = (np, nd, (t + 1) % 8)\n            if state not in visited:\n                visited.add(state)\n                q.append((np, nd, t + 1, path + [act]))\n    return None\n\npath = solve()\nprint(\"Safe distance solution length:\", len(path) if path else \"None\")\nprint(\"Path:\", path)\n'","time":{"start":1794706050550,"end":1794706050583}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dcd10df00014OXwnL7e9zxm0i","sessionID":"ses_e23351e5fffe4TsyviCQE6LMpu","messageID":"msg_1dcd0e480001A6jQ9gwfZAxHRJ"}}
